title: Battle of Valtetsi
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Valtetsi", at revision 1376718096, opens: "The Battle of Valtetsi was fought on 24 May 1821 in Valtetsi between the Ottoman army and Greek revolutionaries." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2579501, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1821 battle of the Greek War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
